items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Because Mutt and them left with a short in it.

ctx.x: Because we were on the river boats. I think you're right. I want to ask you a question. See, because they left that, in 1919 of that, that summer. Because they left around the same time we left. Because Mutt and them left with a short in it. I'll tell you where you get through. Yeah.
